params.description: The earliest unix timestamp for when a record was created.

params.name: max_created
params.description: The latest unix timestamp for when a record was created.

params.description: The earliest unix timestamp for when a record last changed.

params.description: The latest unix timestamp for when a record last changed.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of records to skip before selecting the first result.

params.name: sort_on
params.description: The value to sort a search result of listings on.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: The ascending(up) or descending(down) order to sort receipts by.

params.name: was_paid
params.description: When `true`, returns receipts where the seller has received payment for the receipt. When `false`, returns receipts where payment has not been received.

params.name: was_shipped
params.description: When `true`, returns receipts where the seller shipped the product(s) in this receipt. When `false`, returns receipts where shipment has not been set.

params.name: was_delivered
params.description: When `true`, returns receipts that have been marked as delivered. When `false`, returns receipts where shipment has not been marked as delivered.

params.name: was_canceled
params.description: When `true`, the endpoint will only return the canceled receipts. When `false`, the endpoint will only return non-canceled receipts.
